Two button ingots of Nb-15Si-22Ti-2Al-2Hf-2V-2Cr (2Cr alloy) and Nb-15Si-22Ti-2Al-2Hf-2V-14Cr (14Cr alloy), each with a weight of 1500 g, were prepared by vacuum non-consumable arc melting (AC) in a copper water-cooled crucible under high purity argon atmosphere with a tungsten electrode. The button ingots were melted six times to ensure chemical homogeneity.

attributes.location: metal-mould interface, around solid-liquid interface, retained in metal matrix

evidence.quote: Zhang [19] found a reaction layer of HfO 2 and Y 2O3 formed only at metal-emould interface (3 e8 mm in thickness) in the Nb eSi based alloy and the crucible system. In addition, the majority of the HfO 2eY2O3 inclusions concentrated around the solid eliquid interface rather than in steady state growth region, however, some HfO 2eY2O3 inclusions were retained in the metal matrix.
